grok.performance_metric: 50% Decker interest divested Sept 2014; $74.3M gain, later $52.2M port-rights impairment
grok.rationale: The slice documents only the Sept 2014 sale of the registrant's 50% non-operating Decker Mine interest to the co-owner, with liability assumption, a $74.3M pre-tax gain, and subsequent revenue/cost declines attributed to the exit; no realized product/process misalignment is described, so p4_pathway=0. Likewise no fracture at the operations-versus-organization/culture interface is recorded over the window, only the clean divestiture and a later $52.2M impairment of port-access rights received as consideration, so p5_pathway=0.
